name: Journey to Stonetalon Peak
label: Quest
description: Journey to Stonetalon Peak: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The forest spirits tell me you are brave and willing to travel.

To the south, not far from Mystral Lake, there lies a tunnel named The Talondeep Path. Through this tunnel you will come to an area known as Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. Once there, journey to the southwest past Cragpool Lake and then north, up the steep slope until you reach Stonetalon Peak.
There awaits Keeper Albagorm. Heed his bidding, traveler.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Finally, you arrive. I see Faldreas has listened to the forest spirits....

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
